Management Plan

- Diagnosis of presumed simple urinary tract infection (UTI) based on reported symptoms
- Prescribed antibiotics: Nitrofurantoin or Trimethoprim (one tablet, twice daily, for three days)
- Advised to increase oral fluids and may try cranberry juice for symptomatic relief
- Recommended to abstain from sexual activity until symptoms resolve; continue barrier contraception use
- Advised to seek medical attention if symptoms worsen (fever, back pain, feeling unwell) or do not improve after completing antibiotics
- Follow-up: To contact clinic if not improved by end of the week or with concerning symptoms
- Patient education provided on treatment expectations and warning signs
